entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A wild plane of volatile mana, hedrons, the Roil and dangerous lands, explored by expeditionary houses.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: The upheaval that redraws Zendikar's world as it passes, leaving only hedrons unchanged.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Ancient floating stone structures of Zendikar that perplex minds and survive the Roil.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who has seen planes leveled and scorns vampires who gorge without savoring.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who says the world's might wins and that the forest's blood is beholden to no one; the elves say she will save only the worthy.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who finds Zendikar's land seems intent on killing her.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind-mage who needs only his foe to have an imperfect plan.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
entities.description: A planeswalker who lost his spark and plots revenge on Zendikar, whose mana fractured his soul.

entities.name: Zahr Gada
entities.description: A Halimar expedition leader who warns of lost fingers and treasures of Sejiri.

entities.name: Bruse Tarl
entities.description: A Goma Fada nomad who judges hurdas.

entities.name: Hazir
entities.description: A Sejiri cartographer who has seen the winner of survival's game.

entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: A Kamsa cleric who speaks of honoring places and gods that slumber.

entities.name: Arhana
entities.description: A Kazandu trapfinder who advises explorers to be slippery and lucky.

entities.name: Nikou
entities.description: A Joraga bard who comments on tales and alliances.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A Tazeem lullmage who says life is a maze and spots holes in plans.

entities.name: Tarsa
entities.description: A Sea Gate sell-sword who jokes about drakes and Guul Draz.

entities.name: Jaby
entities.description: A Silundi Sea nomad who compares a shoal serpent to a reef.

entities.name: Sachir
entities.description: A member of the Akoum Expeditionary House.

entities.name: Ilori
entities.description: A merfolk falconer who observes tern nests on sky hedrons.

entities.name: Rana Cloudwake
entities.description: A kor skyfisher who explains where to hook a windrider eel.

entities.name: Javad Nasrin
entities.description: An Ondu relic hunter who speaks of land swollen with mana and relics.

entities.name: Kalitas, Bloodchief of Ghet
entities.description: A vampire bloodchief who tells others to guard their thoughts.

entities.name: Samila
entities.description: A Murasa Expeditionary House member who deals with sell-swords and goblins.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: An Oran-Rief survivalist who distrusts settlements.

entities.name: Tala Vertan
entities.description: A Makindi shieldmate who tells a mage to stop pontificating.

entities.name: Nablus
entities.description: A North Hada trapper who trades scales and claws.

entities.name: Mitra
entities.description: A Bala Ged missionary who endured the rock fall at Shatterskull Pass.

entities.name: Sheyda
entities.description: An Ondu gamekeeper.

entities.name: Chadir the Navigator
entities.description: A navigator who has known true ferocity and scorns planar-walkers.

entities.name: Zurdi
entities.description: A goblin who loses interest in treasure when trapped by a lethargy trap.

entities.name: Frek
entities.description: A goblin who recalls 2,070 of 2,071 survival tips.

entities.name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
entities.description: A vampire sage who seeks the fingerprints of oppressors in bloodstains and the reason hedrons awoke.

entities.name: Radavi
entities.description: A Joraga relic hunter who speaks defiant last words.

entities.name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
entities.description: A giant octopus from a deepwater realm to whom tides bow.

entities.name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
entities.description: An angel of Emeria who ends the righteous cowering before evil.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: The sky goddess whom merfolk call Emeria and kor call Kamsa.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A rope-wielding people of Zendikar who return to homelands forgotten.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Slumbering godlike beings, hinted at by the monument.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: A vampire city with traps hinting at its thirst.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A life-draining region of Zendikar.

entities.name: Shatterskull Pass
entities.description: A pass where rocks fall all night and giants are angry.

entities.name: Akoum Mountains
entities.description: Mountains of raging rocks and living fires.

entities.name: Sky Ruin
entities.description: Ruin protected by shifting hedrons and Roil winds.

entities.name: Halimar Sea Caves
entities.description: Breeding ground of giant squids and dumping ground of criminals.

entities.name: Ora Ondar
entities.description: Region where a fragment of ancient power is lost.

events.summary: Zahr Gada warns that lost fingers and toes are nothing compared to the lost treasures of Sejiri.
events.quote: Trust me, your lost fingers and toes are nothing compared to the lost treasures of Sejiri.

events.summary: Sorin Markov says he has seen planes leveled without pleasure.
events.quote: I have seen planes leveled and all life rendered to dust.

events.summary: Iona's might ends the cowering of the righteous before evil.
events.quote: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

events.summary: Nissa Revane asks why fight the world when you know who will win.
events.quote: Why fight the world when you know who will win?

events.summary: Zendikar's volatile mana makes spectacular spells and astonishing failures.
events.quote: Zendikar's volatile mana is the basis for many spectacular spells

events.summary: Zurdi, caught in a lethargy trap, stops caring about treasure and the circling drakes.
events.quote: Suddenly, Zurdi didn't care about treasure, glory, food

events.summary: Jace Beleren says he needs only his foe to have an imperfect plan.
events.quote: I don't need to have the perfect plan.

events.summary: Most Zendikar inhabitants give up on an accurate map as seas spread.
events.quote: Most inhabitants of Zendikar have given up on the idea of an accurate map.

events.summary: Sorin Markov criticizes vampires who gorge without savoring the kill.
events.quote: The vampires of this world don't know the pleasures of hunger.

events.summary: Kalitas, Bloodchief of Ghet, warns others to guard their thoughts.
Ob Nixilis, the Fallen, having lost his spark, plots revenge on Zendikar.
events.quote: His spark lost, he plots revenge upon the plane whose corrupting mana fractured his soul.

events.summary: Chandra Nalaar says the land of Zendikar seems to go out of its way to kill you.
events.quote: The land here seems to go out of its way to kill you.

events.summary: Mitra describes rocks falling like hammers at Shatterskull Pass.
events.quote: Rocks fell all night like hammers smashing an anvil.

events.summary: Elves hold that Nissa will save only those who prove their worth.
events.quote: Nissa will save the elves, but only the ones who have proved their worth.

events.summary: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only hedrons unchanged.
events.quote: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

events.summary: Nissa Revane declares the forest's blood beholden to no one.
events.quote: The blood of the forest is beholden to no one.

events.summary: Chadir the Navigator scorns planar-walkers who do not know wild.
events.quote: Those brazen 'planar-walkers' have no idea what wild really means.

events.summary: Anowon seeks the fingerprints of oppressors in bloodstains.
events.quote: In these bloodstains I will find the fingerprints of our oppressors.

events.summary: Ayli says gods do not die, they merely slumber, beside the Eldrazi monument.
events.quote: Gods don't die. They merely slumber.

relations.note: He plots revenge on the plane.
relations.quote: he plots revenge upon the plane
